notes:
Follow-up release reverting v1.0.32's hand-coded SVG-path wordmark on the splash screen and sharpening every small-size app icon. No functional changes for the trading engine. This is a normal point release - both v1.0.32 and v1.0.33 share the `com.asasystems.terminal` Tauri identifier, so v1.0.32 users update via the in-app updater the same way every other point release lands. No manual install required. ### Fixes - **In-app wordmark reverted to styled text.** v1.0.32 swapped the splash screen's `

ASA Terminal

` for hand-built inline SVG paths (chunky white A's plus a folded-S shape with multi-shade panels) so the splash would mirror the canonical brand pack. The result looked "coded" — clearly geometry rather than the actual logo — and didn't read as the brand. v1.0.33 restores `tray-app/src/App.tsx` to the same styled-text pattern the rest of the surfaces use (`

ASA Terminal

` matching `templates/login.html`, `dashboard.html`, `templates/onboarding.html`, `templates/admin.html`). The Copilot raster (`branding/png/wordmark-on-dark-1200.png`, `wordmark-master.png`) stays reserved for hero/marketing surfaces only — landing-page hero, social banners, OG cards. In-app wordmarks render as scalable styled text that works at every DPI without raster artefacts. - **App / installer icon blur at small sizes.** v1.0.32's icon pipeline rendered `tray-app/src-tauri/icons/32x32.png` and `64x64.png` by downscaling the full ASA wordmark from 1024px. The three letters squashed to ~10 px tall and lost stroke separation in the taskbar, alt-tab thumbnail, and file-explorer view. `scripts/build_icon.py` now promotes the glyph-only S treatment from `<= 48` to `<= 64` px inclusive, so 16/24/32/48/64 each render the green folded-S element from `wordmark-master.png` natively (no wordmark detail to squash) on the same charcoal rounded square. 128/256 keep the full ASA wordmark — those have room. Verified via direct ICO sub-image extraction that all seven embedded resolutions are now sharp at 32-bit colour. - **Tray, PyInstaller, NSIS icon sources unified.** Confirmed `tray-app/src-tauri/icons/icon.ico` (Tauri bundle.icon and tauri.conf.json `installerIcon`), `build/asa-terminal.ico` (PyInstaller `server.exe` icon directive in `build/server_sidecar.spec`), and `branding/png/icon.ico` (source-of-truth in the brand pack) are all byte-identical and rebuilt from the same `build_icon.py` pass. The four .ico mirrors share an MD5, so every Windows surface (window decoration, Start-menu shortcut, file-explorer .exe icon, NSIS installer .exe icon, embedded `server.exe` icon) renders from the same atlas. The Tauri tray icon source (`tray-disconnected.png` and the four state companions) was deliberately left untouched — those are connection-state glyphs, not brand icons, and were never the source of the report. - **Landing-page favicons rebuilt.** `marketing/landing/branding/favicon-{16,32,48,64}.png` and `marketing/landing/branding/icon.ico` had the same wordmark-downscale problem. Rebuilt from the glyph-only S source at native sizes via the same `build_icon.py` pass. `apple-touch-icon-180.png` keeps the full wordmark — at 180px the letters have room. ### Auto-updater note Same shipping pipeline as v1.0.30 / v1.0.31 / v1.0.32: PyInstaller `server.exe` sidecar -> Tauri NSIS bundle -> manual minisign with `npx tauri signer sign -f - -p ""` from bash (NOT auto-signer in PowerShell pipes - that produces 0-byte sigs) -> SHA256 + UTF-8-no-BOM `latest.json` -> `gh release create` -> uploaded to `cjml34483/TradeSpace-releases`. v1.0.32 -> v1.0.33 auto-updates cleanly because the Tauri identifier hasn't changed.
